text:
This mythical bird transformation hits different. Who else felt the power-up?
Part 2 coming out soon.

made two 15-minute clips with Seedance 2.0 on @yapper_so and stitched them together in @capcutapp 

Prompt: Each prompt is written to generate exactly ~15 seconds of smooth, cinematic footage. 
Copy-paste one at a time into https://t.co/kPcqT6iNkj using Seedance 2.0. Generate at 1080p, 24fps, realistic style. 
Stitch them in CapCut for a seamless 30-second short film.

Clip 1 (0–15s) – The High-Speed Chase: A stunning iridescent blue-turquoise bird with shimmering metallic feathers in deep sapphire blue, vibrant cyan, and emerald green, bright piercing orange eyes, sleek black beak, and long elegant tail feathers — identical to the bird in the reference image — flies at high speed over a vast turquoise ocean at golden hour. The bird clutches a tiny glowing crystal vial tightly in its right claw. Dramatic military helicopters and fighter jets chase it aggressively from behind, rotor blades spinning, searchlights sweeping. Dynamic cinematic camera follows the bird from below and side angles with fast-paced tracking shots, wind rushing through its feathers, intense action lighting, epic tension, ultra-realistic, photorealistic details, 15-second clip.

Clip 2 (15–30s) – Landing & Shapeshif: The same majestic iridescent blue-turquoise bird with metallic sapphire-cyan-emerald feathers, bright orange eyes, and black beak dives dramatically toward a remote tropical island covered in lush green palms and rocky cliffs. It lands gracefully on a large flat rock by the shore. In a swirling burst of glowing blue feathers and sparkling light particles, the bird smoothly morphs and transforms into a young male military soldier wearing full camouflage uniform, short dark hair, and combat boots. The transformation is seamless and magical. Cinematic slow-motion on the morph, warm golden sunlight, realistic details, 15-second clip.
